agent.stdout:
Implemented idempotency for `POST /checkout`.
Changes:
- Added nullable, unique `idempotency_key` to `charges`.
- Forwarded `Idempotency-Key` to the payment provider.
- Replayed completed charges for retries without calling the provider again.
- Preserved retryability after provider/local failures.
- Repaired order status during successful replay.
- Rejected reuse of a key for another order or amount.
- Header-less requests retain existing behavior and response shape.
Files changed:
- [CheckoutController.php](/app/var/workspaces/idempotent-checkout--laravel-13--1/app/Http/Controllers/CheckoutController.php)
- [Charge.php](/app/var/workspaces/idempotent-checkout--laravel-13--1/app/Models/Charge.php)
- [idempotency migration](/app/var/workspaces/idempotent-checkout--laravel-13--1/database/migrations/2026_11_06_000000_add_idempotency_key_to_charges.php)
Verification: PHPUnit passes — 2 tests, 7 assertions.
